name: Timon Free
free_limit: Free local AI-agent orchestration workstation for one user on one machine, including agent missions, Kanban, git worktrees, code/review workflows, routines, local memory, built-in browser and plugins; works with separately provided agent CLI subscriptions, credentials or endpoints.
watch_out: Timon Free is local software, not free hosted AI inference or compute. Claude Code, Codex, Copilot and other model CLI subscriptions/API usage must be separately provided and may cost money. Free is limited to one user and one machine, with no support; multi-user roles, premium plugins and server-based Cloud edition require a paid plan. Main Timon code is AGPL-3.0-only with a plugin exception; distributing modified software or providing a modified network service may trigger source-sharing obligations. Pro/Cloud pricing has not been announced.
